benefits: High polyphenol anthocyanin antioxidants
Low glycemic index natural sweetness
Hand-picked carefully with stem crowns intact

products.name: Baby Wild Arugula / Roquette

products.name: Fresh Whole Farm Pasteurized Milk (1L)
products.description: Fresh gently-pasteurized whole cow milk from grass-fed herd. Non-homogenized cream top.
benefits: Natural calcium & Vitamin D
Pure grass-fed nutrition
Cream top richness without additives
products.storageAdvice: Keep refrigerated at 1°C - 4°C at all times. Consume within 5 days of opening.

products.name: Artisan Pure Butter Shortbread Biscuits
products.description: Traditional slow-baked pure butter Scottish-style shortbread fingers, melt-in-the-mouth texture with rich cream butter flavor.
benefits: Made with 100% natural creamery butter
Zero palm oil, preservatives, or artificial flavorings
Pair wonderfully with fresh cardamom milk tea
products.storageAdvice: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry pantry.

products.name: Gourmet Cocoa Swirl & Butter Tea Biscuits
products.description: Crisp, golden-baked tea cookies with delicate swirls of Belgian cocoa and madagascar vanilla.
benefits: Light, crunchy golden bake perfect with afternoon tea
Real vanilla pod extract and dutch-processed cocoa
products.storageAdvice: Keep sealed in a cool, dry place.

products.name: Artisanal Single-Origin Cocoa Truffles
products.description: Velvety dark chocolate ganache infused with organic cream, dusted in Dutch cocoa powder and crushed caramelized almonds.
benefits: Crafted with 70% single-origin dark cocoa
Rich in natural flavonoids and antioxidants
Elegant luxury packaging suitable for gifting

products.name: Handcrafted 70% Dark Chocolate & Sea Salt Bar
products.description: Velvety smooth bean-to-bar dark chocolate with hand-harvested sea salt flakes and roasted whole almond pieces.
benefits: Zero refined white sugar or artificial emulsifiers
Grown and traded under strict ethical fair-trade sourcing
products.storageAdvice: Store in a cool, dry cabinet away from direct sunlight.

products.name: Grade-A Royal Persian Saffron Threads
products.description: Sargol super-negin whole crimson saffron threads. Deep intoxicating aroma, intense ruby coloration, and unparalleled depth for biryani, tea, or rice.
benefits: Highest ISO 3632 coloring power rating (>250)
100% pure handpicked stigmata with zero yellow styles
Natural mood and wellness booster
products.storageAdvice: Store in the sealed metal tin in a dark, cool pantry.

products.name: Organic Ceylon Cinnamon Quills & Bark
products.description: True Ceylon cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) fragrant soft quills. Delicately sweet aroma with low coumarin content, ideal for pastries, curries, and teas.
benefits: True Ceylon variety with minimal natural coumarin
Smooth sweet warmth with no harsh astringency
products.storageAdvice: Keep tightly closed in its glass jar away from moisture.

products.name: Kettle-Cooked Sea Salt Potato Crisps
products.description: Thick-cut farm russet potatoes kettle-fried in pure sunflower oil and seasoned with hand-harvested flaky sea salt. Maximum golden crunch!
benefits: Cooked in small batches for extraordinary crunch
Zero MSG, artificial preservatives, or trans fats
products.storageAdvice: Store in a dry pantry. Reseal tightly after opening.

products.name: Artisan Stone-Ground Tortilla Crisps (Lime & Pepper)
products.description: Non-GMO stone-ground corn chips seasoned with zesty sun-ripened lime, cracked black pepper, and pink Himalayan salt.
benefits: Made from non-GMO stone-ground whole corn kernels
Perfect sturdy chip for guacamole and salsa dipping
products.storageAdvice: Store in a cool dry place.
